findings.verdict: no admissible uniform tiling of a width-66 bank absorbs two whole bins at once, and neither rank 16 nor rank 20 fits the bank count its own volume criterion prices

obligations.C1: unchanged: the normalizer and item-to-block maps the bank construction owes
obligations.T1: the enumeration above: the mixed tiling ranks 16 and 20 owe has no uniform solution, so it must remove part of a retained bin (padding) or use a different bank width -- the pins state neither, so the rungs above rung 2 stay priced rather than instantiated

top.note: no family of the remaining complex ledger has a whole-bank volume, so the accounting criterion the built rungs use cannot be applied again without a different bank width or a mixed tiling that reopens the volume condition; the T1 scan of this certificate shows the mixed tiling has no uniform solution either, and that rungs 3 and 4 are priced at 192 and 60 banks where their own capacities require 198 and 66
